points.text: ECI announced the **SSR** of electoral rolls for **6** States/UTs (Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Odisha, Sikkim, Chandigarh, DNH&DD) where SIR is complete — draft rolls **30 Nov**, final **21 Jan 2027**; Aadhaar stays voluntary.
points.plain: ECI announced the SSR of electoral rolls for 6 States/UTs (Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Odisha, Sikkim, Chandigarh, DNH&DD) where SIR is complete — draft rolls 30 Nov, final 21 Jan 2027; Aadhaar stays voluntary.

points.text: Activists demanded FIRs over alleged **Form 7 forgery** in Delhi's Mustafabad; **₹47.56 lakh** names were dropped from Delhi's draft roll; final roll deadline pushed to **22 December**.
points.plain: Activists demanded FIRs over alleged Form 7 forgery in Delhi's Mustafabad; ₹47.56 lakh names were dropped from Delhi's draft roll; final roll deadline pushed to 22 December.

points.text: ECI restored oversight of its **IT wing** (headed by Seema Khanna) under a Deputy Election Commissioner, reversing a July order, after ECs S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi objected.
points.plain: ECI restored oversight of its IT wing (headed by Seema Khanna) under a Deputy Election Commissioner, reversing a July order, after ECs S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi objected.

points.text: SC (Justice **Ujjal Bhuyan**): **arrest begins** the moment an official **touches** a person to restrain liberty — starts the **24-hour** clock then; held **beyond 24 hours** must be freed, detention time recorded.
points.plain: SC (Justice Ujjal Bhuyan): arrest begins the moment an official touches a person to restrain liberty — starts the 24-hour clock then; held beyond 24 hours must be freed, detention time recorded.

points.text: Centre told the SC it is weighing a panel to review the **UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026**, stayed by the SC in **January 2026** as 'too sweeping'; the older 2012 Regulations continue to apply.
points.plain: Centre told the SC it is weighing a panel to review the UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026, stayed by the SC in January 2026 as 'too sweeping'; the older 2012 Regulations continue to apply.

points.text: Census 2027 will be India's **first fully digital Census**; door-to-door count begins **1 December** in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab and Goa, tracked via the **CMMS** app.
points.plain: Census 2027 will be India's first fully digital Census; door-to-door count begins 1 December in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab and Goa, tracked via the CMMS app.

points.text: NPCI told the SC **'zero MDR' on UPI is unsustainable**; the new **0.4% MDR** applies only to Person-to-Merchant transactions **above ₹2,000** — P2P and small P2M stay free.
points.plain: NPCI told the SC 'zero MDR' on UPI is unsustainable; the new 0.4% MDR applies only to Person-to-Merchant transactions above ₹2,000 — P2P and small P2M stay free.

points.text: Israel's Arab-majority **Joint List** and **Ra'am** backed **Gadi Eisenkot** (not PM Netanyahu) to form the next government after the inconclusive 27 Oct election; President **Isaac Herzog** gives the mandate.
points.plain: Israel's Arab-majority Joint List and Ra'am backed Gadi Eisenkot (not PM Netanyahu) to form the next government after the inconclusive 27 Oct election; President Isaac Herzog gives the mandate.

points.text: Iran reported two more tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the **Strait of Hormuz**; UKMTO reported a tanker hit by projectiles off Qatar.
points.plain: Iran reported two more tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz; UKMTO reported a tanker hit by projectiles off Qatar.

points.text: On US midterm day, President **Trump** announced the US will stop its roughly **$4-billion** annual military aid to Israel by year-end, citing political costs after a candidate's anti-aid stance helped flip Michigan.
points.plain: On US midterm day, President Trump announced the US will stop its roughly $4-billion annual military aid to Israel by year-end, citing political costs after a candidate's anti-aid stance helped flip Michigan.

points.text: US VP **J.D. Vance** blamed the **Iran war** for the Republican midterm defeat, positioning himself as front-runner for the **2028** Republican presidential nomination.
points.plain: US VP J.D. Vance blamed the Iran war for the Republican midterm defeat, positioning himself as front-runner for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination.

points.text: DRDO successfully flight-tested the indigenous quasi-ballistic missile **Pralay** from Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha, clearing the way for its induction into the armed forces.
points.plain: DRDO successfully flight-tested the indigenous quasi-ballistic missile Pralay from Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha, clearing the way for its induction into the armed forces.

points.text: Govt clarified **Agnipath is not rolled back**: the 25% retained after 4 years continue as before; the remaining 75% get a second 2-year engagement before joining the regular cadre with **protected seniority**.
points.plain: Govt clarified Agnipath is not rolled back: the 25% retained after 4 years continue as before; the remaining 75% get a second 2-year engagement before joining the regular cadre with protected seniority.

points.text: CERT-In named China-linked hacking group **'Crafty Falcon'**, which used AI tools (ARTEX, PentAGI, Cairn, CyberStrikeAI) to breach Indian non-bank lenders, fintechs and crypto exchanges 'at machine speed'.
points.plain: CERT-In named China-linked hacking group 'Crafty Falcon', which used AI tools (ARTEX, PentAGI, Cairn, CyberStrikeAI) to breach Indian non-bank lenders, fintechs and crypto exchanges 'at machine speed'.

points.text: **CERT-In** issued 'AI Security Auditing Guidelines' for **agentic AI** systems that plan tasks and delegate work on their own, calling for audits of permission overreach and emergency 'stop' mechanisms.
points.plain: CERT-In issued 'AI Security Auditing Guidelines' for agentic AI systems that plan tasks and delegate work on their own, calling for audits of permission overreach and emergency 'stop' mechanisms.

points.text: ISRO chief V. Narayanan confirmed navigation satellite **NVS-03** (launched 30 Oct) is 'fully healthy' after its engine fired for **6,400 seconds** to reach circular orbit.
points.plain: ISRO chief V. Narayanan confirmed navigation satellite NVS-03 (launched 30 Oct) is 'fully healthy' after its engine fired for 6,400 seconds to reach circular orbit.

points.text: NPPA capped trade margins at **30%** on **137** non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs, cutting prices of nearly **900** brands by **70-93%**; but **194 of 1,024** analysed brands saw **no** price cut.
points.plain: NPPA capped trade margins at 30% on 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs, cutting prices of nearly 900 brands by 70-93%; but 194 of 1,024 analysed brands saw no price cut.

points.text: A *Nature Medicine* global study of **6.1 million** people in 118 countries found women report more pain than men at **all 11** body sites studied — **83%** higher for facial pain.
points.plain: A Nature Medicine global study of 6.1 million people in 118 countries found women report more pain than men at all 11 body sites studied — 83% higher for facial pain.

points.text: A **tokamak** confines fusion plasma using **magnetic fields** in a ring shape; **ITER** (7 members incl. India) is being built at **Cadarache, France**; India's tokamaks are **ADITYA/ADITYA-U** and **SST-1** at Gandhinagar.
points.plain: A tokamak confines fusion plasma using magnetic fields in a ring shape; ITER (7 members incl. India) is being built at Cadarache, France; India's tokamaks are ADITYA/ADITYA-U and SST-1 at Gandhinagar.

points.text: An **unauthorised** 3-storey building under construction collapsed in old Delhi's **Chawri Bazar**, killing 2 — Delhi's **3rd** major building collapse since 6 September.
points.plain: An unauthorised 3-storey building under construction collapsed in old Delhi's Chawri Bazar, killing 2 — Delhi's 3rd major building collapse since 6 September.

points.text: **859** sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank jobs (2014-2025); SC's *Dr. Balram Singh* (2023) raised death compensation to **₹30 lakh** per worker.
points.plain: 859 sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank jobs (2014-2025); SC's Dr. Balram Singh (2023) raised death compensation to ₹30 lakh per worker.

points.text: India beat Japan **4-1** in the Asian Champions Trophy hockey final in Mohali to retain the title — its **6th ACT crown in 7 editions**; Hardik Singh played his **200th** international match.
points.plain: India beat Japan 4-1 in the Asian Champions Trophy hockey final in Mohali to retain the title — its 6th ACT crown in 7 editions; Hardik Singh played his 200th international match.

points.text: **Cristiano Ronaldo** (41) retired from international football as Portugal's all-time (world-record) scorer with **146 goals in 234 matches**.
points.plain: Cristiano Ronaldo (41) retired from international football as Portugal's all-time (world-record) scorer with 146 goals in 234 matches.

points.text: Delhi-Services Ranji Group-C match ended in a draw: Rajat Paliwal (116) and Mohit Ahlawat (142) powered Services; Yash Dhull (104*) rescued Delhi chasing 320 in 54 overs.

points.text: **Chennai Super Kings** traded for Liam Livingstone and Jack Edwards from Sunrisers Hyderabad, giving up Khaleel Ahmed and Nathan Ellis, ahead of IPL 2027 — CSK's first trade under coach Zaheer Khan.
